# genexpert.py for why (Puzzle Bobble 2 is a two-player game, and the
# arcade shapes were measured not to be what made it hard).

# drops every SHOTS-minus-missing-colours shots, so it accelerates as the
# board empties. DROPTIME is the anti-idle FALLBACK only.
#
# '.' = empty, '1'..'8' = colour. Even rows 8 cells, odd rows 7, indented.
# 1 red  2 green  3 blue  4 yellow  5 cyan  6 magenta  7 grey  8 white
